title: Options to Reform the Tax Treatment of Exempt Hospitals
summary: Nearly half of all hospitals are exempt from paying US corporate income taxes. As healthcare spending rises, lawmakers have questioned whether hospitals are providing as much in community benefits as they derive from tax exemptions.

title: Expensing Concentrates the Corporate Tax Burden on Economic Profits
summary: As scrutiny over data center investment and AI rises, some commentators are concerned about how expensing interacts with these ongoing investments. Most of these concerns misunderstand what expensing does.

title: 2026 Economics Nobel Laureate Robert Hall Helped Lay Foundation for Pro-Growth Tax Reform
summary: Hall’s research helped economists understand how taxes distort investment decisions, while his work with Rabushka shows how to minimize those distortions. Although the US remains far from a pure consumption tax, Hall’s work informs efforts to reduce the tax burden on investment,...

title: Amendment 3: A Restructuring of Florida’s Local Tax Base
summary: Florida has long maintained one of the nation’s most competitive state tax codes, but a fundamental change proposed by Amendment 3 could undermine that competitiveness.

title: International Tax Competitiveness Index 2026
summary: While there are many factors that affect a country's economic performance, taxes play an important role. A well-structured tax code is easy for taxpayers to comply with and can promote economic development while raising sufficient revenue for a government’s priorities.

title: The California Billionaire Tax’s Ever-Shifting Goalposts
summary: Wealth taxes have been a failure everywhere they’ve been tried, which may be why advocates for the California amendment are saying this is a new frontier. But the countries that have tried this gamble know the frontier well, and they’ve left it in the dust.

title: Washington Voters Will Decide Whether to Keep or Reject an Income Tax on High Earners
summary: Washington’s new income tax on high earners doesn’t take effect until 2028, but it is already generating a lot of activity. A measure on the ballot this November, Initiative 645, would reverse the legislature’s decision, preventing the new tax from taking effect.

title: Spain’s Transformation After a Decade of Fiscal Competition
summary: The 2026 Regional Tax Competitiveness Index for Spain highlights a growing divergence between regions that have embraced tax reform and those whose tax systems have remained largely unchanged.

title: Why the US Needs a Fiscal Commission to Help Solve the Debt Crisis
